rules.statement: The stipulations in P2 are valid as lex commissoria concerning the payment of the balance consideration and the consequences of default.
rules.supporting_quote: P1 and P2 should be read together; and the stipulations in P2 would operate as to the payment of the balance consideration and the consequence of the default be valid as lex commissoria. Per Bandaranayake, J. "it appears that P3 was attested by the seller's notary out of an abundance of caution to strengthen the position of the seller. It certainly cannot detract from the reversion of the title to the seller upon the failure to pay the balance consideration as stated above."
